citations.title: Nokia announces new strategy, evolution of its operating model, new long-term financial target, strategic KPIs and changes to its Group Leadership Team

sentences.quote: Nokia is simplifying its operational model into two primary operating segments of Network Infrastructure and Mobile Infrastructure.
sentences.text: At its November 2025 strategy update, Nokia said it would simplify its operating model into two primary segments, Network Infrastructure and Mobile Infrastructure, and target annual comparable operating profit of EUR 2.7 to 3.2 billion by 2028, with Mobile Infrastructure led by Justin Hotard on an interim basis; Hotard said Nokia "changed the world once by connecting people - and will again by connecting intelligence".

Site Implementation and Outside Plant
sentences.text: Four units, including private wireless, were placed under review for possible sale in 2026 as not fitting the strategy.

Kristen Pressner, from Roche, started as Chief People Officer and Group Leadership Team member on 1 April 2026, and Emma Falck, from Siemens, was appointed President of Mobile Infrastructure effective 1 September 2026.
